capabilities: Render a Base's filtered notes as a force-directed graph on canvas
Track explored status per note in frontmatter
Track note maturity levels and graduated notes
Read and edit notes in a side panel from graph nodes
Search, filter and batch-toggle nodes with minimap and zoom controls
disambiguation: Not a whole-vault graph browser; it only renders the notes returned by a Base's query.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later for the Bases and declarative settings APIs; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; warns that manual or BRAT installs can put an incompatible build in the vault; README lists many other plugins by the same author.
intentEvidence: adds a custom Bases view which renders notes as an interactive force-directed graph
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph always shows the whole vault and offers no way to scope it to a filtered subset or track which notes you have already processed.

relations.evidence: Force-directed layout via force-graph on a 2D canvas.

summary: Custom Bases view that renders the notes matching a Base's filters as an interactive force-directed graph with explored/unexplored and maturity tracking.
